title: Restore an enabled task-record validation CI gate
description:
## Summary

Restore a durable, enabled task-record validation gate. The task that introduced the durable task format (CC-093) listed a GitHub Actions workflow validating `Data/Tasks/*.json` as an explicit scope/acceptance item, but after the MemorySmith migration the CI was disabled and is now absent at HEAD. The migration therefore removed its own continuous validation gate at the exact moment schema drift is most likely.

Provenance: `docs/audits/creaturecreator-deep-dive-code-review-audit-26-09-05-23-07-45.md` F1 (P1). Verified at current HEAD `99fe6ad`: no `.github/workflows` exists. Broad owner family: task-system migration / retirement (TSK-0101); CC-093 record is now retired. This is the one clearly net-new accepted item with no clean active owner.

## Scope

- Restore an active GitHub Actions workflow that validates the durable task records in `Data/Tasks/*.json`.
- Keep `Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1` as the authoritative JSON validation step.
- Decide explicitly whether the legacy Markdown tracker validator (`docs/tasks/tools/task_validate.py`) remains required now that the Markdown tracker is frozen; do not silently drop both.
- Name the workflow to describe task-data validation (not generic Unity CI), unless full CI is intentionally in scope.
- Add an acceptance check that the workflow file is present, enabled, and triggered for `push` and `pull_request`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A workflow file exists under `.github/workflows/` that validates `Data/Tasks/*.json` on push and pull_request.
- The validation step runs `Test-TaskRecords.ps1` and fails on malformed records (bad ids/keys/statuses/priorities/duplicates/control characters).
- The legacy-validator decision is explicit and recorded.
- A malformed task record intentionally fails the gate (manual or local proof).

## Validation

Local run of `Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1` over the current tree passes. Confirm the workflow is syntactically valid and its trigger is `push`/`pull_request`. No Unity run is required; this is a repo/tooling gate.

## Findings

- CC-093 acceptance required an automated task-record validation workflow on push/PR.
- Commit `4ac0f72` disabled CI after the MemorySmith migration; no `.github/workflows` directory exists at HEAD, so even a disabled-trigger workflow is gone.
- Two parsers/validators plus a migration layer exist; that is exactly when continuous validation is most valuable.

## Blockers

None known.

## Next Step

Author and enable the workflow; run `Test-TaskRecords.ps1` locally to confirm the current tree passes.
